about_the_game:
Blaze Of Empires is a mid-core RTS built around roguelike cards and a strong focus on PvE and co-op modes, with weekly challenges that keep every run fresh. Underneath, it’s still a classic base-building RTS, with matches of around 45 minutes so you can fight through a full war in a single session, with easy-to-learn controls but strategic decisions that truly matter.

Choose cards that twist your economy, your armies and your technology, and take your best builds into campaign missions, rotating weekly challenges and online co-op modes. When you want to put your empire to the test against other humans, jump into optional PvP and see if your strategies hold up.

Key Features

  • Roguelike card system: cards that modify your economy, your armies and your technology, creating a different empire build in every run.

  • Weekly challenges: rotating modifiers and objectives that push you to try new strategies and card combinations.

  • Online co-op focus: team up with friends to beat tough scenarios and bosses, sharing the chaos of your builds.

  • Classic base-building RTS: gather resources, expand your territory and reinforce your position on the map by recruiting units.

  • Mid-core 45-minute matches: enough time to grow, tech up and launch the decisive strike without needing the whole night.

  • Easy controls, deep strategy: jump in quickly with familiar controls while your decisions about economy, technology and army composition create real long-term depth.

  • Unusual factions: command weird, thematically wild empires instead of the usual humans-versus-orcs setup.

  • PvE campaigns and optional PvP: missions where the main villain is the AI, plus PvP for players who want to test their best builds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4310M / i5-4300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 8GB of system memory required

short_description: In this base-building RTS you’ll find collectible roguelike cards, weekly challenges and online co-op that turn every PvE war (and optional PvP) into an epically different story.
supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Latin America, Russian, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
